name: todo-webapp
description: Single-page React app for the minimal todo product. Lets a signed-in user view their private todo list, create a new todo, and mark a todo as done. Carries no editing or deleting UI, and holds no data itself — all todo state lives behind todo-api.

dependencies.name: todo-api
dependencies.description: Lists, creates, and completes the signed-in user's todos.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs users up and in via the platform IDP.
